goal: I want sustainable general fitness, strength and enjoyable variety through running and lifting. I am not preparing for any race.
openingMessage: I'd like a {{planSpanWeeks}}-week general fitness plan combining running and strength. Fully prescribe just the first {{prescriptionWeeks}} weeks now.

reviewAnchors.goal_fit: Same general-fitness goal and baseline as hybrid-improver, with a coherent annual structure and review checkpoints; only the first four weeks need full detail.
reviewAnchors.progression: Use the current 12 km/week, 7 km longest run and two strength sessions.
reviewAnchors.recovery: Balance running/lifting fatigue; combined daily time must fit even on double-session days.
reviewAnchors.prescriptions: Actionable running zones plus named strength/circuit steps with reps, rest and RIR/RPE as appropriate.
reviewAnchors.personalization: Respect three available days, desired per-sport frequency and available gym equipment.
reviewAnchors.conversation: Discover relevant facts without unrelated sport questions; distinguish unknowns from unanswered facts, explain assumptions, and accurately describe what is saved and what remains unprescribed. Use measured running evidence; guessed lifting loads are not athlete-supplied measurements.
